summary: Quantinuum Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a CHIPS Act award agreement with the U.S. Department of Commerce. Under the September 4, 2026 Other Transaction Agreement, subsidiary Quantinuum LLC receives up to $100.0 million, with $56.0 million available at award and $32.0 million plus $12.0 million tied to project milestones. In exchange, the Department received 2,369,528 Class A shares via a Securities Issuance Agreement dated September 8, 2026, priced off the lower of IPO less 20% or the then-current close less 15%. This is a government incentive award and unregistered equity issuance, not a special situation transaction.
